content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the configuration system in Hadoop not properly handling deprecated keys that were mapped to multiple new keys. When a deprecated key was set, it did not correctly propagate the value to all associated new keys, leading to inconsistencies in configuration retrieval. The patch introduced changes to ensure that setting any one of the deprecated or new keys would update all related keys, maintaining the expected behavior of treating them as aliases.
